chapter: Neighborhood halls and the Ida Cox tour
title: Route of the Ida Cox tour up the East Coast
summary: The tour went through the Carolinas and Virginia, perhaps to Washington, ending when school reopened.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Is there anything else about the Ida Cox tour? How far did you go, and where, how long did it last?

Well, I went all, all up in Carolina, all up, mostly on the East Coast, Bill. Uh-huh. Mostly all up in Virginia. I think I went all the way to Washington, D.C. Yeah. Because right after that, they got snowbound somewhere, but I was home then, see. Yeah. Because it was time for school open, see, I made it back home, see. As a matter of fact, Emanuel and I made it back home.
